The US FDA approved a regimen of Merck's Welireg (belzutifan) and Eisai's
Lenvima (lenvatinib) as a second-line therapy for advanced renal cell carcinoma with a clear cell component.

Approval was based on results from the open-label, randomized LITESPARK-011 trial in which patients whose disease progressed after treatment with a PD-1 or PD-L1 inhibitor received either Welireg and Lenvima or Exelixis'
Median progression-free survival was 14.6 months in the combo arm and 10.6 months in the cabozantinib cohort. Median overall survival was, respectively, 33.7 months and 28.6 months.
The recommended dosage is Welireg 120 mg and Lenvima 20 mg daily.

title: Merck Welireg, Eisai Lenvima combo approved for kidney cancer
